source: Ghia, Ghia & Shin (1982), J. Comput. Phys. 48(3):387-411, doi:10.1016/0021-9991(82)90058-4 (metadata verified via api.crossref.org). Original paper is paywalled (Semantic Scholar: openAccessPdf CLOSED) and was NOT read directly. Values cross-checked across independent transcriptions: [A] https://github.com/pypr/pysph/blob/master/pysph/examples/ghia_cavity_data.py ; [B] https://github.com/philipmorrisintl/aerosolved/tree/master/cases/cavity/referenceData (GhiaU.txt, GhiaV.txt) ; [C] https://github.com/DrZGan/Python_CFD/blob/main/Ghia-1982.txt (Table I only) ; [D] https://github.com/barbagroup/cuIBM/blob/master/data/ghia_et_al_1982_lid_driven_cavity.dat (Re 100/1000 only, no Re 400) ; [E] https://github.com/ShotaDeguchi/Cavity_FDM_NumPy2/blob/main/reference.py ; [F] B.Sc. thesis, Uppsala Univ. 2022, https://www.diva-portal.org/smash/get/diva2:1668016/FULLTEXT01.pdf (Tables 1-2, transcribed from Ghia et al.) ; [G] other GitHub copies: Kandil2001/LidCavity_MATLAB validation/ghia_data.m, GuiCT/accelerating-ldcflow-solution, scarpma/ns_game data/ghia_v.dat, dSizovs/yalb, benzwick/StreamVorti data/ghia_1982_u.txt.
notes: Non-dimensional: u,v scaled by lid velocity, x,y by cavity side; lid at y=1 moving in +x. Table I = u along vertical line through geometric centre (x=0.5); Table II = v along horizontal line through geometric centre (y=0.5). Grid 129x129. Order as in original tables (descending coordinate). Discrepancies found among transcriptions and choices made: (1) Table II, Re=400, x=0.5: 0.05188 in [A],[B],[F] vs 0.05186 in [E] and the [G] copies; chose 0.05188 (sources that transcribe the full tables directly from the paper) -- UNRESOLVED without the original scan; difference 2e-5 is immaterial for validation. (2) Table II, Re=400, x=0.9063: -0.23827 in [A],[E],[F],[G] vs -0.38270 in [B] (looks like a hand 'correction'). Kept -0.23827 as printed. WARNING: this entry is widely believed to be a misprint in the original -- it breaks monotonicity between -0.22847 (x=0.9453) and -0.44993 (x=0.8594); thesis [F] explicitly flags it as wrong and excludes it, and its own solvers give about -0.384 there. Recommend excluding this point from error norms. (3) Table II, Re=1000, x=0.5: 0.02526 in [A],[B],[E],[F],[G] vs 0.02426 in [D] (cuIBM/PetIBM); chose 0.02526 (majority). (4) Table II, Re=1000, x=0.9063: -0.51550 everywhere except -0.51500 in [E]; chose -0.51550. (5) Table I, Re=400, y=0.7344: 0.16256 everywhere except 0.16257 in StreamVorti; chose 0.16256. (6) Re=100 columns agree in all sources. Also noted (outside Re<=1000): Table I Re=3200 y=0.4531 printed as -0.86636 in several copies (evident misprint, -0.08636 or -0.08664 elsewhere); Re=10000 y=0.5 sign differs between copies. StreamVorti's ghia_1982_v.txt is corrupted (its columns do not match Table II) and was disregarded.
